text: Get started and make your first API call within minutes of signup
quote: Make your first Cerebras API call in just minutes.

text: Try models in a no-signup, no-API-key playground in the Cloud Console
quote: Use the playground in the Cloud Console — no key or install needed.

text: OpenAI-compatible endpoint lets existing apps switch by changing only API key, base URL, and model ID
quote: OpenAI API compatibility lets developers build on Cerebras with just two code changes.

text: Supports streaming responses that render incrementally as tokens are generated
quote: The Cerebras API supports streaming responses, which send messages back in chunks and display them incrementally as the model generates them.

text: Structured Outputs constrains responses to a JSON schema for reliable parsing
quote: Structured Outputs constrains model responses to a JSON schema so applications can process generated data reliably.

text: Tool/function calling lets the model invoke functions defined by the application
quote: Tool calling, also known as tool use or function calling, lets a model request functions that your application defines.

text: Batch API processes groups of requests asynchronously for non-realtime workloads
quote: The Batch API lets you process groups of requests asynchronously, making it perfect for workloads where you don't need immediate results

text: Dedicated endpoints provide a private, reserved inference instance isolated from other customers' traffic
quote: A dedicated endpoint is a private, provisioned instance of the Cerebras Inference service reserved exclusively for your organization.

text: Custom fine-tuned models can be deployed alongside standard model variants
quote: Deploy your custom fine-tuned models alongside standard model variants.

text: Documentation guides users to the right open-source model, including alternatives for Claude, GPT, and Gemini
quote: Find the right open-source model for your workload on Cerebras, including alternatives for Claude, GPT, and Gemini.

text: Cached (prefix) tokens don't count against uncached TPM limits, letting higher cache hit rates process more total tokens
quote: Cached tokens don't count toward your uncached TPM limit, so a higher cache hit rate lets you process far more total tokens within the same uncached limit.

text: New accounts get $5 in free credit to prototype before paying
quote: Get started with $5 in free credits after making an account

text: Paid self-serve tier offers 10x higher rate limits and higher priority processing than free tier
quote: Self-serve payment starting at just $10 * 10x higher rate limits than free tier * Higher priority processing

text: Supports OpenAI-style image_url content (base64 data URI) for vision inputs
quote: The standard OpenAI `image_url` content shape is supported. Supply the image as a base64 data URI

text: Cerebras Inference is also accessible through partner APIs
quote: Get access to Cerebras Inference through our partner APIs

text: SDK sends TCP warming requests on construction to reduce time-to-first-token
quote: This SDK has a mechanism that sends a few requests to `/v1/tcp_warming` upon construction to reduce the TTFT.

text: Official Python SDK available via pip install
quote: pip install --upgrade cerebras_cloud_sdk

text: Official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK provides server-side access to the REST API
quote: This library provides convenient access to the Cerebras REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.

text: Model catalog page lets users browse all models available on public endpoints
quote: Browse all models available on Cerebras public endpoints.

text: Marketed for commercial use with high throughput inference
quote: Build commercially with high throughput

text: Dedicated endpoint runs on reserved capacity so performance is never impacted by other customers' workloads
quote: Your endpoint runs on reserved capacity that is not shared with other customers, so your performance is never impacted by other workloads.

text: Per-model pages show full specs, capabilities, and per-tier rate limits
quote: Select any model name below for full specs, capabilities, and per-tier limits.

text: Can reason through entire codebases including complex requirements and dependencies for coding tasks
quote: Reason through entire codebases, including complex requirements, dependencies, and edge cases, without disrupting developer workflows.

text: Supports running long autonomous agent loops with open-source models, cutting task time from hours to minutes
quote: Run long agent loops with strong open-source models, reducing hours of work to minutes.
